items.title: Harbor Glass
items.goal: Large slowly rearranging stained-glass cells, hairline seams, and close Jewelry refractions.

intent.concept: Large slowly rearranging stained-glass cells, hairline seams, and close Jewelry refractions.
intent.design_intent: Hold the ship inside five immense stained-glass panes whose Voronoi borders migrate almost imperceptibly, with broad colored material on the Hull, a crisp seam drawing on the Silhouette, and only rare optical catches in Jewelry.
intent.why_exists: It supplies a finite architectural glass look for ambient use: large cells and lead seams, not water, caustics, noise, or a repeating wave lattice.
intent.visual_goal_titanic: From the playa the vessel should read as a continuously visible teal-and-gold glass icon; nearer viewers should discover pane identity, refraction, dark lead, and small jewel catches without losing the ship outline.
intent.unique_topology: A fixed five-site 3D nearest/second-nearest Voronoi field; the literal d2-d1 gap creates lead seams while per-cell palette positions create five broad panes.
intent.distance_silhouette: Silhouette strands invert the normal pane treatment into a bright, crisp seam perimeter over a persistent lit floor, so the outline stays complete even when Hull seams are dark.
intent.close_detail: Lens falloff, near-lead refraction, five ordered palette positions, sparse golden-angle Vintage gem cuts, and catchlights occupying under 8% of their analytic cycle.
intent.motion_grammar: Five independently clocked sites drift on golden-angle placements at irrationally related rates; the geometry rearranges continuously rather than scrolling, pulsing, or visibly looping.
intent.xyz_use: World X/Y/Z all participate in the five 3D distance checks and in each site's migration. Identity computes signIndex = index % 74 and remaps that folded address into one complete 10x8/74-pixel local surface; both physical 40+34 signs therefore use identical local coordinates.

fixture_roles.Jewelry: Sparse palette-line gem refractions plus restrained matched-white catchlights.
fixture_roles.Organs: Steady anchors biased toward the warm palette endpoint; structural rather than sparkly.
fixture_roles.Identity: Both physical signs render the same complete, non-repeating 74-pixel stained-glass pane map, including border, lens, cell identity, and active X/Y detail.

intent.te_sign_treatment: Both physical signs render the same complete, non-repeating 74-pixel stained-glass pane map, including border, lens, cell identity, and active X/Y detail. The lower 34 addresses continue the surface and do not repeat addresses 0-33.
intent.jewelry_white: Only rare Vintage catchlights emit native white; W and A use the exact same expression and UV remains zero. Control: sliderJewelryGlint; capture value 0.22.
intent.palette_white_material: Strict RGB interpolation between cool harbor teal and warm glass gold, with refraction expressed as movement along that line rather than a third hue. Native white only on sparse Jewelry catches, always W=A; amber is not independent and UV=0.

items.goal: One immense compass rose holds the vessel while a broad luminous meridian crosses behind its north-locked needle.
